data.title: Cozy Home Interiors
data.summary: Stylized modular room shells, living, kitchen, bedroom, bath, hobby and mood props for warm domestic scenes.
data.description: Hearth stylized interior kit in metre units: 1 m grid wall modules with wall-run connectors and named door pivots, 2 m floor and ceiling tiles, a stair flight, and rounded chunky furniture and props in one warm eight-colour palette. Static CC0 geometry prepared for human review.
